title: 3BR Rosemary Beach Home with a Private Pool & Beach Access
meta_description: Relax in this 3BR, 3.5BA Rosemary Beach home, with an open floor plan, multiple private balconies, a fireplace, a game table, and a private pool. Sleeps 9.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Southern Serenity Cottage
normalized_matching_profile.description: DescriptionOn the western end of our quaint coastal town lies Southern Serenity Cottage, a home perfect for a large family or group couples getaway. The West Indies inspired architecture is quintessential Rosemary Beach style, and its comfortable interior will make you feel right at home.The first floor features the sleeping quarters including a guest room with King bed and second guest room with Queen bed joined by a Jack and Jill full bath. The master bedroom has a comfortable King bed and its own private bathroom with separate tub and shower, granite countertops and walk in closet. Each of the bedrooms has their own flat screen TV including the bonus third story closed-in loft with private bath, bunk bed, and separate twin bed - perfect for kids and late night story telling.The main living floor on the second story boasts an open floor plan, vaulted ceilings and multiple private balconies making this an easy space for entertaining many guests. Watch your favorite game on the oversized flat screen TV with surround sound, nestle by the fireplace, or get comfy at the game table while trying your hand at chess. Also on the main floor is the kitchen featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances and dining area to accommodate six plus nearby circular table accommodating up to four. After dinner, head outside for some fresh air on the shuttered balcony overlooking your private courtyard.Both the Cabana Pool & Barbados Pool are within walking distance as well as local boutiques, delectable restaurants, and our beautiful beaches. Prefer to stay in? No problem. Relax in your private pool with sundeck featuring lounge chairs, grill, and outdoor eating area. Sweet Southern Serenity – a sweet home away from home.Need a little more space? Check out the Southern Serenity Carriage House, located above the garage in the courtyard. Rents separately.HOME HIGHLIGHTS:• Private Heated Pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)• Large Courtyard with Outdoor Dining • Clean Bedding Program• Flat Screen TV’s in All Bedrooms• SONOS Sound System• Harmony Elite All-in-One Remote & Apple TV• 1 Minute Walk to Cabana & Barbados Pools• Driveway Parking and Two Car Garage• Fireplace• 3 Minute Walk to the BeachHOME LAYOUT: (Sleeps 8)FIRST FLOOR• Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Tub and Shower• Guest Room: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo• Guest Room: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Queen Guest RoomSECOND FLOOR• Kitchen and Living Room• Dining Room with Seating for 6• Half BathroomTHIRD FLOOR• Guest Room Loft: Bunk Bed (2 Twins) & Twin Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only• For more room, this lot also has a 2 bedroom Southern Serenity Carriage House (Sleeps 6) that rents separately at a discount if rented togetherAMENITIES INCLUDED: • High-Speed Mesh Wireless Internet• 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes• Access to Rosemary Beach Fitness Center and Tennis Courts (Additional Cost)• Access to the 4 Community Pools in Rosemary Beach
